nodes.label: The Occupancy Clock (tick k − g)
nodes.rationale: Λ₉'s composition has 33 objects and 739 of 1,089 ordered pairs joined by a step, and no step raises k. The object graph falls into three strongly connected components pure in occupancy (8 at k=3, 15 at k=2, 10 at k=1) with no return between, so time in this index is a counting phenomenon, not a coupling one.

nodes.label: Definability Is Not Reachability
nodes.rationale: Over 2,735,716 ordered cell pairs, 11.4 % are lattice-comparable, 24.7 % joined by a composition path, and only 0.4 % both: the lattice says what a cell is, composition what it can become, and running them together is the error this census forecloses.

nodes.label: Nine as the Unique Dimension at Which Time Exists
nodes.rationale: As a dimension the nine-dimensional-time reading is false — the composition preorder quotients to a chain of order dimension one; as a location it is exact, since Λ₈ cannot iterate and Λ₁₀ loses composition.
